virtualXid.description: Virtual transaction id holding the lock.

class.description: Postgres class name for locked object.

objId.description: Postgres oid of the table being locked.

objSubId.description: Postgres oid of the column in the table being locked.

granted.description: True if lock has been granted, false if it is waiting to be granted.

fastpath.description: True if lock was taken via Postgres fastpath.

clientAddr.description: Client ip address of lock owner.

clientHostname.description: Client host name of lock owner.
